question: Could you help me determine which actor starred most frequently in English-language children's category films that were rated either G or PG, had a running time of 120 minutes or less, and were released between 2000 and 2010? Please provide the actor's full name.
gold_sql:
SELECT
    actor.first_name || ' ' || actor.last_name AS full_name
FROM
    actor
INNER JOIN film_actor ON actor.actor_id = film_actor.actor_id
INNER JOIN film ON film_actor.film_id = film.film_id
INNER JOIN film_category ON film.film_id = film_category.film_id
INNER JOIN category ON film_category.category_id = category.category_id
-- Join with the language table
INNER JOIN language ON film.language_id = language.language_id
WHERE
    category.name = 'Children' AND
    film.release_year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2010 AND
    film.rating IN ('G', 'PG') AND
    language.name = 'English' AND
    film.length <= 120
GROUP BY
    actor.actor_id, actor.first_name, actor.last_name
ORDER BY
    COUNT(film.film_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

first_label.label: intended
first_label.reason: No film repeats within an actor group after the Children filter (no duplicate film_actor/film_category pairs), so COUNT equals COUNT DISTINCT and HELEN VOIGHT stays on top.

second_label.corrected_sql: SELECT actor.first_name || ' ' || actor.last_name AS full_name FROM actor INNER JOIN film_actor ON actor.actor_id = film_actor.actor_id INNER JOIN film ON film_actor.film_id = film.film_id INNER JOIN film_category ON film.film_id = film_category.film_id INNER JOIN category ON film_category.category_id = category.category_id INNER JOIN language ON film.language_id = language.language_id WHERE category.name = 'Children' AND film.release_year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2010 AND film.rating IN ('G', 'PG') AND language.name = 'English' AND film.length <= 120 GROUP BY actor.actor_id, actor.first_name, actor.last_name ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT film.film_id) DESC LIMIT 1;

first_label.reason: Floor areas are summed once per room on the floor, e.g. STATA CENTER assignable area 11,048,807 vs 285,682; ranking changes.

question: For the port with ID `25d421c1-c76d-4c26-9550-9f871a1d5034`, list each allowed address pair’s MAC address and IP address along with the port ID, the bound security group ID, the running average of that port’s standard attribute ID (ordered by allowed address pair IP address, keeping only rows where this running average is greater than 0), and for the same security group also show the geometric mean of standard attribute IDs across its bound ports (considering only ports with standard attribute ID > 0) plus the overall average of these per–security group geometric means across all security groups. gold_sql: WITH sg_geom AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, EXP(AVG(LN(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID))) AS geometric_mean_standard_attr_id FROM PORTS AS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS s ON p.ID = s.PORT_ID WHERE p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID > 0 GROUP BY s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID ORDER BY geometric_mean_standard_attr_id DESC) SELECT inner_cte.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, inner_cte.geometric_mean_standard_attr_id, avg_sg.avg_geometric_mean_standard_attr_id FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT AVG(geometric_mean_standard_attr_id) AS avg_geometric_mean_standard_attr_id FROM inner_cte) AS avg_sg ON 1 = 1 ORDER BY inner_cte.geometric_mean_standard_attr_id DESC), port_aap AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT aap.MAC_ADDRESS AS allowed_mac_address, aap.IP_ADDRESS AS allowed_ip_address, p.ID AS port_id, sgpb.SECURITY_GROUP_ID AS security_group_id, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY p.ID ORDER BY aap.IP_ADDRESS) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN ALLOWEDADDRESSPAIRS AS aap ON p.ID = aap.PORT_ID WHERE p.ID = '25d421c1-c76d-4c26-9550-9f871a1d5034' ORDER BY aap.IP_ADDRESS) SELECT allowed_mac_address, allowed_ip_address, port_id, security_group_id, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > 0 ORDER BY allowed_ip_address) SELECT port_aap.allowed_mac_address, port_aap.allowed_ip_address, port_aap.port_id, port_aap.security_group_id, port_aap.window_column AS running_avg_standard_attr_id, sg_geom.geometric_mean_standard_attr_id, sg_geom.avg_geometric_mean_standard_attr_id FROM port_aap JOIN sg_geom ON port_aap.security_group_id = sg_geom.SECURITY_GROUP_ID ORDER BY port_aap.allowed_ip_address

question: For ports that are DOWN and are also bound to the security group ID 0008e629-5619-41e0-b86c-4eecfeaacb6c, show the port ID, tenant ID, MAC address, port status, and allocated IP address, along with (1) the running sum of the port’s standard attribute ID within each security group (ordered by standard attribute ID) and (2) the running sum of the port’s standard attribute ID within each network (ordered by standard attribute ID). gold_sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH down_ports_window AS (SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, SUM(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY sgpb.SECURITY_GROUP_ID ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS window_column FROM SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb JOIN PORTS AS p ON sgpb.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN'), admin_up_ports_security AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(psb.port_id) AS binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN psb.port_security_enabled THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS port_security_enabled_total FROM ports AS p JOIN portsecuritybindings AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address) SELECT COUNT(*) AS down_ports_with_admin_up_security_count FROM down_ports_window AS dpw JOIN admin_up_ports_security AS aups ON dpw.port_id = aups.port_id AND dpw.tenant_id = aups.tenant_id AND dpw.mac_address = aups.mac_address), TenantDownAdminUpCounts AS (SELECT p.tenant_id, COUNT(*) AS total_matching_ports FROM ports AS p JOIN SECURITYGROUPPORTBINDINGS AS sgpb ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN PORTSECURITYBINDINGS AS psb ON psb.port_id = p.id WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' AND p.admin_state_up = 1 GROUP BY p.tenant_id), AverageTenantCount AS (SELECT AVG(total_matching_ports) AS avg_matching_ports FROM TenantDownAdminUpCounts) SELECT t.tenant_id, t.total_matching_ports, a.avg_matching_ports AS benchmark, CASE WHEN t.total_matching_ports > a.avg_matching_ports * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_USER' WHEN t.total_matching_ports < a.avg_matching_ports * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_USER' ELSE 'AVERAGE_USER' END AS user_category, inner_cte.down_ports_with_admin_up_security_count AS overall_matching_ports_count FROM TenantDownAdminUpCounts AS t CROSS JOIN AverageTenantCount AS a CROSS JOIN inner_cte

question: For the port status value 'DOWN', list the status-level variance of PORTS.STANDARD_ATTR_ID across ports that have an IP allocation, along with each port-binding host and that host’s variance of PORTS.STANDARD_ATTR_ID considering only DOWN ports that have an IP allocation; also include, for each host, the total number of DOWN ports with an IP allocation and the average of that host-level port count across all hosts. gold_sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH PortStatusVariances AS (SELECT p.STATUS, (AVG(CAST(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID AS REAL) * CAST(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID AS REAL)) - AVG(CAST(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID AS REAL)) * AVG(CAST(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID AS REAL))) AS standard_attr_id_variance FROM PORTS AS p JOIN IPALLOCATIONS AS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE NOT p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID IS NULL GROUP BY p.STATUS ORDER BY standard_attr_id_variance DESC), DownPortHostVariances AS (SELECT b.HOST, (AVG(CAST(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID AS REAL) * CAST(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID AS REAL)) - AVG(CAST(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID AS REAL)) * AVG(CAST(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID AS REAL))) AS standard_attr_id_variance FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN IPALLOCATIONS AS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND NOT ia.PORT_ID IS NULL GROUP BY b.HOST ORDER BY standard_attr_id_variance DESC) SELECT psv.STATUS, psv.standard_attr_id_variance AS status_standard_attr_id_variance, dhv.HOST, dhv.standard_attr_id_variance AS down_host_standard_attr_id_variance FROM PortStatusVariances AS psv JOIN DownPortHostVariances AS dhv ON psv.STATUS = 'DOWN' WHERE NOT psv.standard_attr_id_variance IS NULL ORDER BY psv.standard_attr_id_variance DESC, dhv.standard_attr_id_variance DESC) SELECT i.STATUS, i.status_standard_attr_id_variance, i.HOST, i.down_host_standard_attr_id_variance, host_counts.down_ports_with_ip_count, avg_host_counts.avg_down_ports_with_ip_count FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN (SELECT b.HOST, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS down_ports_with_ip_count FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN IPALLOCATIONS AS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND NOT ia.PORT_ID IS NULL GROUP BY b.HOST) AS host_counts ON i.HOST = host_counts.HOST, (SELECT AVG(down_ports_with_ip_count) AS avg_down_ports_with_ip_count FROM (SELECT b.HOST, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS down_ports_with_ip_count FROM ML2_PORT_BINDINGS AS b JOIN PORTS AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN IPALLOCATIONS AS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND NOT ia.PORT_ID IS NULL GROUP BY b.HOST) AS sub) AS avg_host_counts ORDER BY i.status_standard_attr_id_variance DESC, i.down_host_standard_attr_id_variance DESC, host_counts.down_ports_with_ip_count DESC

question: For each port status that appears both among ports with a security group port binding and a port security binding and among ports with an IP allocation (and a non-null standard attribute ID), show the status, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of standard attribute IDs, the variance of standard attribute IDs, the overall average coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) across these statuses, and the deviation of each status’s coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) from that overall average, ordered by the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) descending. gold_sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH sq1 AS (SELECT p.status, CAST(SQRT(ABS(AVG(CAST(p.standard_attr_id AS REAL) * CAST(p.standard_attr_id AS REAL)) - AVG(CAST(p.standard_attr_id AS REAL)) * AVG(CAST(p.standard_attr_id AS REAL)))) AS REAL) / NULLIF(AVG(p.standard_attr_id), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM securitygroupportbindings AS sgpb JOIN ports AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN portsecuritybindings AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id GROUP BY p.status HAVING AVG(p.standard_attr_id) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC), sq2 AS (SELECT p.STATUS, (AVG(CAST(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID AS REAL) * CAST(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID AS REAL)) - AVG(CAST(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID AS REAL)) * AVG(CAST(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID AS REAL))) AS standard_attr_id_variance FROM PORTS AS p JOIN IPALLOCATIONS AS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE NOT p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID IS NULL GROUP BY p.STATUS ORDER BY standard_attr_id_variance DESC) SELECT sq1.status, sq1.coefficient_of_variation, sq2.standard_attr_id_variance FROM sq1 JOIN sq2 ON sq1.status = sq2.status ORDER BY sq1.coefficient_of_variation DESC), avg_stats AS (SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.status, i.coefficient_of_variation, i.standard_attr_id_variance, a.avg_coefficient_of_variation, (i.coefficient_of_variation - a.avg_coefficient_of_variation) AS deviation_from_avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN avg_stats AS a ORDER BY i.coefficient_of_variation DESC

gold_sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH RbacSharedIpVersionVariance AS (SELECT n."ACTION", (AVG(CAST(s.IP_VERSION AS REAL) * CAST(s.IP_VERSION AS REAL)) - AVG(CAST(s.IP_VERSION AS REAL)) * AVG(CAST(s.IP_VERSION AS REAL))) AS ip_version_variance FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE n."ACTION" = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n."ACTION" ORDER BY ip_version_variance DESC), RbacIpVersionStats AS (SELECT n."ACTION" AS rbac_action, AVG(s.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version, MAX(s.IP_VERSION) - MIN(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_range, (AVG(CAST(s.IP_VERSION AS REAL) * CAST(s.IP_VERSION AS REAL)) - AVG(CAST(s.IP_VERSION AS REAL)) * AVG(CAST(s.IP_VERSION AS REAL))) AS ip_version_variance FROM NETWORKRBACS AS n JOIN SUBNETS AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION IN (4, 6) GROUP BY n."ACTION" ORDER BY ip_version_range DESC) SELECT rs."ACTION" AS rbac_action, rs.ip_version_variance AS shared_action_ip_version_variance, ris.avg_ip_version, ris.ip_version_range, ris.ip_version_variance AS overall_ip_version_variance FROM RbacSharedIpVersionVariance AS rs JOIN RbacIpVersionStats AS ris ON rs."ACTION" = ris.rbac_action ORDER BY rs.ip_version_variance DESC) SELECT i.rbac_action, i.shared_action_ip_version_variance, i.avg_ip_version, i.ip_version_range, i.overall_ip_version_variance, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s2.IP_VERSION = 6 THEN s2.ID END) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_any_ipv6_subnet_on_referenced_networks FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN NETWORKRBACS AS n2 ON n2."ACTION" = i.rbac_action JOIN SUBNETS AS s2 ON s2.NETWORK_ID = n2.OBJECT_ID GROUP BY i.rbac_action, i.shared_action_ip_version_variance, i.avg_ip_version, i.ip_version_range, i.overall_ip_version_variance ORDER BY i.shared_action_ip_version_variance DESC

question: For each port status that appears in both result sets, return the port status along with (1) the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of ports’ standard attribute IDs for ports that have both a security group port binding and a port security binding, and (2) the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the allocated IP address string lengths for ports with port security enabled; additionally, only keep statuses where more than 75% of the distinct ports in that status have at least one IP allocation. Do not return any rounded answers.
gold_sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH StdAttrIdCV_ByStatus AS (SELECT p.status, CAST(SQRT(ABS(AVG(CAST(p.standard_attr_id AS REAL) * CAST(p.standard_attr_id AS REAL)) - AVG(CAST(p.standard_attr_id AS REAL)) * AVG(CAST(p.standard_attr_id AS REAL)))) AS REAL) / NULLIF(AVG(p.standard_attr_id), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM securitygroupportbindings AS sgpb JOIN ports AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN portsecuritybindings AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id GROUP BY p.status HAVING AVG(p.standard_attr_id) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC), IpAddressLenCV_ByStatus AS (SELECT p.status, CAST(SQRT(ABS(AVG(CAST(LENGTH(ia.ip_address) AS REAL) * CAST(LENGTH(ia.ip_address) AS REAL)) - AVG(CAST(LENGTH(ia.ip_address) AS REAL)) * AVG(CAST(LENGTH(ia.ip_address) AS REAL)))) AS REAL) / NULLIF(AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM portsecuritybindings AS psb JOIN ports AS p ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN ipallocations AS ia ON p.id = ia.port_id WHERE psb.port_security_enabled = 1 GROUP BY p.status HAVING AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT s1.status, s1.coefficient_of_variation AS std_attr_id_coefficient_of_variation, s2.coefficient_of_variation AS ip_address_length_coefficient_of_variation FROM StdAttrIdCV_ByStatus AS s1 JOIN IpAddressLenCV_ByStatus AS s2 ON s1.status = s2.status) SELECT i.status, i.std_attr_id_coefficient_of_variation, i.ip_address_length_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN ports AS p ON p.status = i.status LEFT JOIN ipallocations AS ia ON ia.port_id = p.id GROUP BY i.status, i.std_attr_id_coefficient_of_variation, i.ip_address_length_coefficient_of_variation HAVING CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NOT ia.ip_address IS NULL THEN p.id END) * 1.0 AS REAL) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT p.id), 0) > 0.75

question: For IPv4 subnets whose routes have next hop 10.30.19.197/8, list each subnet route’s destination and next hop along with the subnet name and CIDR and the allocation pool’s first and last IP (including a dense rank per subnet), and also show the subnet-level range and variance of allocation pool starting IPs (FIRST_IP) for that subnet. gold_sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT b.BUILDING_USE, (AVG(CAST(r.AREA AS REAL) * CAST(r.AREA AS REAL)) - AVG(CAST(r.AREA AS REAL)) * AVG(CAST(r.AREA AS REAL))) AS area_variance, SQRT(ABS(AVG(CAST(r.AREA AS REAL) * CAST(r.AREA AS REAL)) - AVG(CAST(r.AREA AS REAL)) * AVG(CAST(r.AREA AS REAL)))) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS r JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST AS b ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE NOT r.AREA IS NULL AND NOT b.BUILDING_USE IS NULL AND b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND b.SITE = 'MIT' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_USE) SELECT ic.BUILDING_USE, ic.area_variance, bh.BUILDING_NAME_LONG AS building_with_largest_area FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN (SELECT b.BUILDING_USE, b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, SUM(r.AREA) AS total_area, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b.BUILDING_USE ORDER BY SUM(r.AREA) DESC) AS rn FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS r JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST AS b ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE NOT r.AREA IS NULL AND NOT b.BUILDING_USE IS NULL AND b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND b.SITE = 'MIT' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_USE, b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG) AS bh ON ic.BUILDING_USE = bh.BUILDING_USE AND bh.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.area_variance DESC LIMIT 1

question: From the top 10 academic years with the highest standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of enrolled students in library subjects offered during terms in that year (considering only years with more than 5 subjects offered, and only including subjects that are offered in the fall term and are from the Mathematics department), display each academic year's description, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of enrolled students, and the subject with the highest enrollment in that year, along with its subject title and number of enrolled students. Do not return any rounded answers.
gold_sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, SQRT(ABS(AVG(CAST(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS REAL) * CAST(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS REAL)) - AVG(CAST(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS REAL)) * AVG(CAST(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS REAL)))) AS stddev_num_enrolled_students FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON lso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON lso.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING COUNT(*) > 5) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.stddev_num_enrolled_students, ls.SUBJECT_ID AS Top_Subject_ID, ls.SUBJECT_TITLE AS Top_Subject_Title, ls.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS Top_Enrollment FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, lso.SUBJECT_ID, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC) AS rn FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON lso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON lso.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y') AS ls ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ls.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND ls.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.stddev_num_enrolled_students DESC LIMIT 10

question: List, for each department, the department name, the average and variance of the number of enrolled students in Chemistry courses with at least one associated material record, and the average and variance of the total units for subjects offered by degree-granting departments (excluding Biology) in the 2022 academic year. For each row, indicate the reason for inclusion as either 'ChemistryEnrollment' or 'DegreeDeptUnits'. The columns should be: department name, average enrollment, enrollment variance, average total units, variance of total units, and reason for inclusion, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
gold_sql: WITH ChemistryEnrollmentStats AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment, (AVG(CAST(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS REAL) * CAST(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS REAL)) - AVG(CAST(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS REAL)) * AVG(CAST(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS REAL))) AS enrollment_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE WHERE td.RECORD_COUNT > 0 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY enrollment_variance DESC), DegreeDeptUnitStats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, (AVG(CAST(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS AS REAL) * CAST(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS AS REAL)) - AVG(CAST(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS AS REAL)) * AVG(CAST(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS AS REAL))) AS var_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), CombinedStats AS (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_enrollment, enrollment_variance, NULL AS avg_total_units, NULL AS var_total_units, 'ChemistryEnrollment' AS Reason FROM ChemistryEnrollmentStats UNION ALL SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL, NULL, avg_total_units, var_total_units, 'DegreeDeptUnits' AS Reason FROM DegreeDeptUnitStats) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_enrollment, enrollment_variance, avg_total_units, var_total_units, Reason FROM CombinedStats ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For each academic year, provide the academic year, academic year description, the range and variance of the number of enrolled students in courses (considering only courses that are offered in the current term, have more than zero enrolled students, and are in the Mathematics department with available course materials), as well as the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered in regular terms by the Mathematics department. Present the results ordered by the enrolled student range in descending order. Do not return any rounded answers.
gold_sql: WITH enrolled_stats AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, (AVG(CAST(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS REAL) * CAST(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS REAL)) - AVG(CAST(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS REAL)) * AVG(CAST(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS REAL))) AS enrolled_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR), units_stats AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, SQRT(ABS(AVG(CAST(ss.TOTAL_UNITS AS REAL) * CAST(ss.TOTAL_UNITS AS REAL)) - AVG(CAST(ss.TOTAL_UNITS AS REAL)) * AVG(CAST(ss.TOTAL_UNITS AS REAL)))) AS stddev_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT es.ACADEMIC_YEAR, us.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, es.enrolled_range, es.enrolled_variance, us.avg_total_units, us.stddev_total_units FROM enrolled_stats AS es JOIN units_stats AS us ON es.ACADEMIC_YEAR = us.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY es.enrolled_range DESC

question: For the Mathematics department (Course 18), what is the department name, the average, range, and variance of the total units for courses offered by that department (considering only courses with total units greater than 0 and departments that are degree granting), and what are the average and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the 2022 academic year (excluding the Biology department and considering only degree-granting departments)? question: For each academic year, list either (1) the academic year, average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the maximum enrollment for IAP activities that required advance sign-up and are offered by the Department of Mathematics (Course 18), or (2) for each subject offered by the Mathematics department, the academic year, subject code, subject number, subject title, department name, term code, term description, and the maximum total units for each subject considering the current row and the next 2 rows ordered by subject code, only for subjects that are offered this year and are letter graded. Indicate the source of each row as either 'IAPMaxEnrollStats' or 'MathSubjectUnits'. The columns should be: academic year, subject code, subject number, subject title, department name, term code, term description, maximum total units for 3 rows, average maximum enrollment, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of maximum enrollment, and source. Do not return any rounded answers.

question: For the Mathematics department, provide the department name, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for reserved library materials, the variation category (indicating whether the coefficient is 'HIGH_VARIATION', 'LOW_VARIATION', or 'AVERAGE' compared to the average coefficient across all departments), the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by the department (considering only subjects that are offered this year and are letter graded), as well as the school name and the department phone number. gold_sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, (AVG(CAST(SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS REAL) * CAST(SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS REAL)) - AVG(CAST(SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS REAL)) * AVG(CAST(SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS REAL))) AS enrolled_students_variance FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' AND SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC), MathDeptSubjects AS (SELECT cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects, MIN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.enrolled_students_variance, ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms.num_unique_subjects, ms.min_total_units, ms.avg_total_units FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN MathDeptSubjects AS ms ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ms.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC, ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME

gold_sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled, (AVG(CAST(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS REAL) * CAST(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS REAL)) - AVG(CAST(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS REAL)) * AVG(CAST(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS REAL))) AS enrolled_variance, SQRT(ABS(AVG(CAST(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS REAL) * CAST(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS REAL)) - AVG(CAST(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS REAL)) * AVG(CAST(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS REAL)))) AS enrolled_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = '4' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY enrolled_variance DESC), DeptUnitsStats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, (AVG(CAST(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS AS REAL) * CAST(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS AS REAL)) - AVG(CAST(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS AS REAL)) * AVG(CAST(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS AS REAL))) AS var_total_units, COUNT(ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.SUBJECT_ID) >= 5 ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.avg_enrolled, icte.enrolled_variance, icte.enrolled_stddev, dus.avg_total_units, dus.var_total_units FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN DeptUnitsStats AS dus ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY icte.enrolled_variance DESC

question: Show the school names, the average and variance of the department budget codes for all departments and subject codes associated with each school (only including the departments Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry), and for each department in that school (excluding Mathematics) where the maximum total units of any course offered by that department is greater than 6, also provide the department name, the maximum total units, and the number of distinct subject codes offered by that department. List the results ordered by budget variance descending, then by maximum total units descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
gold_sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_budget, (AVG(CAST(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE AS REAL) * CAST(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE AS REAL)) - AVG(CAST(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE AS REAL)) * AVG(CAST(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE AS REAL))) AS budget_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_CODE = SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE NOT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NULL AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME IN ('Mathematics', 'Physics', 'Chemistry', 'Biology') AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Biology' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY budget_variance DESC) SELECT icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.avg_budget, icte.budget_variance, dmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dmu.max_total_units, dmu.num_subject_codes FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, s.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS num_subject_codes FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS c ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6) AS dmu ON icte.SCHOOL_NAME = dmu.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY icte.budget_variance DESC, dmu.max_total_units DESC

question: For each degree-granting department (excluding the Biology and Chemistry departments), what is the department name, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in graduate-level subjects offered by that department, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects it offers with more than 0 enrolled students (excluding the Chemistry department), and the total number of unique graduate-level subjects offered by the department? List the department name, enrolled students variance, enrolled students standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and the count of unique graduate-level subjects in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
gold_sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, (AVG(CAST(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS REAL) * CAST(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS REAL)) - AVG(CAST(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS REAL)) * AVG(CAST(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS REAL))) AS enrolled_students_variance, SQRT(ABS(AVG(CAST(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS REAL) * CAST(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS REAL)) - CAST(SUM(CAST(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS REAL)) * SUM(CAST(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS REAL)) AS REAL) / COUNT(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS)) AS REAL) / NULLIF(COUNT(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - 1, 0))) AS REAL) / AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 1), grad_subject_count AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID) AS num_grad_subjects FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND NOT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance, inner_cte.enrolled_students_stddev, dept_coefficient_of_variation.coefficient_of_variation, grad_subject_count.num_grad_subjects FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN dept_coefficient_of_variation ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_coefficient_of_variation.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN grad_subject_count ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = grad_subject_count.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.enrolled_students_variance DESC

question: For each department, what is the department name, the variance of the total units of subjects offered in the 2022 academic year, and the average number of enrolled students in those subjects? Do not return any rounded answers.
gold_sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, (AVG(CAST(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS AS REAL) * CAST(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS AS REAL)) - AVG(CAST(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS AS REAL)) * AVG(CAST(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS AS REAL))) AS total_units_variance FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.COURSE_NUMBER = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_units_variance, AVG(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.COURSE_NUMBER = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_units_variance ORDER BY inner_cte.total_units_variance DESC

first_label.reason: Subject summaries repeat once per course-description and 2022 catalog row of their course, uniformly within each department, so the variance and average enrollment are unchanged.

second_label.corrected_sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT x.DEPARTMENT_NAME, (AVG(CAST(x.TOTAL_UNITS AS REAL) * CAST(x.TOTAL_UNITS AS REAL)) - AVG(CAST(x.TOTAL_UNITS AS REAL)) * AVG(CAST(x.TOTAL_UNITS AS REAL))) AS total_units_variance FROM (SELECT DISTINCT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY, SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION ON SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.COURSE_NUMBER = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022) AS x GROUP BY x.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_units_variance, AVG(y.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY, SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.COURSE_NUMBER = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022) AS y ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = y.DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_units_variance ORDER BY inner_cte.total_units_variance DESC

question: For each department, provide the department name, the average and variance of the space unit codes assigned to it (considering only departments with a non-null DLC key and at least one associated space unit), and classify the department as 'HIGH_VARIANCE' if its variance is at least 20% greater than the average variance across all such departments, 'LOW_VARIANCE' if at least 20% less, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Do not return any rounded answers.
gold_sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS avg_space_unit_code, (AVG(CAST(su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE AS REAL) * CAST(su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE AS REAL)) - AVG(CAST(su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE AS REAL)) * AVG(CAST(su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE AS REAL))) AS var_space_unit_code FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS fodk JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON fodk.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS su ON fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE NOT fodk.DLC_KEY IS NULL GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME) SELECT icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.avg_space_unit_code, icte.var_space_unit_code, CASE WHEN icte.var_space_unit_code > avg_stats.avg_variance * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN icte.var_space_unit_code < avg_stats.avg_variance * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte AS icte CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(var_space_unit_code) AS avg_variance FROM inner_cte) AS avg_stats ORDER BY icte.var_space_unit_code DESC

question: For each student year, list the student year and the average, range, and variance of department budget codes for students in that year, considering only students whose department code matches both an academic department and an administrative department, and include only those student years where the average department budget code exceeds the overall average department budget code across all student years. Do not return any rounded answers.
gold_sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.STUDENT_YEAR, AVG(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_budget, MAX(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) - MIN(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS budget_range, (AVG(CAST(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE AS REAL) * CAST(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE AS REAL)) - AVG(CAST(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE AS REAL)) * AVG(CAST(SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE AS REAL))) AS budget_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ON MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.DEPARTMENT = SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE NOT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NULL GROUP BY MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY.STUDENT_YEAR) SELECT inner_cte.STUDENT_YEAR, inner_cte.avg_budget, inner_cte.budget_range, inner_cte.budget_variance FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.avg_budget > (SELECT AVG(avg_budget) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY inner_cte.budget_range DESC

question: For each academic year and department name where the number of enrolled students is greater than 5, what is the number of unique subjects offered, the minimum start date of the academic term, and, for that department, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of courses offered by that department (considering only courses that are offered this year and have a non-null total units value)? List the academic year, department name, subject count, minimum start date, total units range, total units variance, and total units standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
gold_sql: WITH DeptUnitsStats AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccc.total_units) - MIN(ccc.total_units) AS total_units_range, (AVG(CAST(ccc.total_units AS REAL) * CAST(ccc.total_units AS REAL)) - AVG(CAST(ccc.total_units AS REAL)) * AVG(CAST(ccc.total_units AS REAL))) AS total_units_variance, SQRT(ABS(AVG(CAST(ccc.total_units AS REAL) * CAST(ccc.total_units AS REAL)) - AVG(CAST(ccc.total_units AS REAL)) * AVG(CAST(ccc.total_units AS REAL)))) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccc.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND NOT ccc.total_units IS NULL GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC), DeptYearSubjects AS (SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT l.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(a.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_start_date FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS a JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l ON t.TERM_CODE = l.TERM_CODE WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT dys.ACADEMIC_YEAR, dys.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dys.subject_count, dys.min_start_date, dus.total_units_range, dus.total_units_variance, dus.total_units_stddev FROM DeptYearSubjects AS dys LEFT JOIN DeptUnitsStats AS dus ON dys.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dys.ACADEMIC_YEAR, dys.OFFER_DEPT_NAME

question: For each course that has more than 0 enrolled students and a material status key of 'U', list the course number, course number description, number of enrolled students, reserve catalog key, and the dense rank over the material status key ordered by material status key, along with the department name, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of courses offered by that department (considering only courses offered this year with non-null total units). Present the results ordered by course number and course number description. Do not return any rounded answers.
gold_sql: WITH DeptStats AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccc.total_units) - MIN(ccc.total_units) AS total_units_range, (AVG(CAST(ccc.total_units AS REAL) * CAST(ccc.total_units AS REAL)) - AVG(CAST(ccc.total_units AS REAL)) * AVG(CAST(ccc.total_units AS REAL))) AS total_units_variance, SQRT(ABS(AVG(CAST(ccc.total_units AS REAL) * CAST(ccc.total_units AS REAL)) - AVG(CAST(ccc.total_units AS REAL)) * AVG(CAST(ccc.total_units AS REAL)))) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccc.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND NOT ccc.total_units IS NULL GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC), SubjectEnroll AS (SELECT t1.COURSE_NUMBER, t1.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) AS window_column, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U'), CombinedResults AS (SELECT s.COURSE_NUMBER, s.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, s.window_column, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.total_units_range, d.total_units_variance, d.total_units_stddev FROM SubjectEnroll AS s JOIN DeptStats AS d ON s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY COURSE_NUMBER, COURSE_NUMBER_DESC

question: List, for each department, the department code, department name, the range of enrolled students, the variance of enrolled students, and the variance of total units for subjects offered by that department, along with the reason for inclusion ('EnrolledStats' for departments with statistics on enrolled students in graduate-level, degree-granting courses, and 'UnitsVariance' for departments with statistics on the variance of total units for degree-granting subjects with more than 0 enrolled students). The columns should be: department code, department name, range of enrolled students, variance of enrolled students, variance of total units, and reason. Do not return any rounded answers.
gold_sql: WITH EnrolledStats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, (AVG(CAST(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS REAL) * CAST(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS REAL)) - AVG(CAST(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS REAL)) * AVG(CAST(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS REAL))) AS enrolled_variance FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), UnitsVariance AS (SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, (AVG(CAST(sos.TOTAL_UNITS AS REAL) * CAST(sos.TOTAL_UNITS AS REAL)) - AVG(CAST(sos.TOTAL_UNITS AS REAL)) * AVG(CAST(sos.TOTAL_UNITS AS REAL))) AS total_units_variance FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME), CombinedStats AS (SELECT e.DEPARTMENT_CODE, e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.enrolled_range, e.enrolled_variance, NULL AS total_units_variance, 'EnrolledStats' AS Reason FROM EnrolledStats AS e UNION ALL SELECT u.DEPARTMENT_CODE, u.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS enrolled_range, NULL AS enrolled_variance, u.total_units_variance, 'UnitsVariance' AS Reason FROM UnitsVariance AS u) SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, enrolled_range, enrolled_variance, total_units_variance, Reason FROM CombinedStats ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, Reason

question: For each department and academic year where the department's average total units for subjects with more than 0 total units is greater than 6 and the number of unique subjects offered with more than 5 enrolled students is at least 3, provide the department name, the average total units, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units, the academic year, the number of unique subjects offered, and the minimum start date of the academic term, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
gold_sql: WITH DepartmentUnitsStats AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, SQRT(ABS(AVG(CAST(sos.TOTAL_UNITS AS REAL) * CAST(sos.TOTAL_UNITS AS REAL)) - AVG(CAST(sos.TOTAL_UNITS AS REAL)) * AVG(CAST(sos.TOTAL_UNITS AS REAL)))) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY stddev_total_units DESC), AcademicYearDeptSubjects AS (SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT l.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(a.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_start_date FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS a JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l ON t.TERM_CODE = l.TERM_CODE WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dus.avg_total_units, dus.stddev_total_units, ayds.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ayds.subject_count, ayds.min_start_date FROM DepartmentUnitsStats AS dus JOIN AcademicYearDeptSubjects AS ayds ON dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ayds.OFFER_DEPT_NAME WHERE dus.avg_total_units > 6 AND ayds.subject_count >= 3 ORDER BY dus.stddev_total_units DESC, ayds.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC

question: For academic term parameters where the term indicator is 'C', show the term parameter, the term code, the academic year, the department name of the offered subject, the running sum of academic years within each department, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units and at least 1 enrolled student), and classify the department as 'HIGH_VARIANCE' if its standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) is at least 20% greater than the average, 'LOW_VARIANCE' if its standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) is at least 20% less than the average, or 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE' otherwise. Only include departments that offer at least 3 subjects in those terms. Order the results by department name and academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
gold_sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT t0.TERM_PARAMETER, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_INDICATOR = 'C'), DeptCounts AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS subject_count FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE IN (SELECT TERM_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER WHERE TERM_INDICATOR = 'C') GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3), cte1_result AS (SELECT icte.TERM_PARAMETER, icte.TERM_CODE, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.window_column FROM inner_cte1 AS icte JOIN DeptCounts AS dc ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dc.DEPARTMENT_NAME), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, SQRT(ABS(AVG(CAST(s.TOTAL_UNITS AS REAL) * CAST(s.TOTAL_UNITS AS REAL)) - AVG(CAST(s.TOTAL_UNITS AS REAL)) * AVG(CAST(s.TOTAL_UNITS AS REAL)))) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME), cte2_result AS (SELECT inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.avg_total_units, inner_cte2.stddev_total_units, CASE WHEN inner_cte2.stddev_total_units > inner_cte2.avg_total_units * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN inner_cte2.stddev_total_units < inner_cte2.avg_total_units * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte2) SELECT c1.TERM_PARAMETER, c1.TERM_CODE, c1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c1.window_column, c2.avg_total_units, c2.stddev_total_units, c2.variance_category FROM cte1_result AS c1 JOIN cte2_result AS c2 ON c1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = c2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY c1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c1.ACADEMIC_YEAR

question: For each subject offered in the 2012 summer term by the Harvard Cross-Enrollment Program that is also offered in the 2012SU term with a cluster type of 'S', provide the subject key, subject title, department name, the number of subject offerings, the total number of units for those offerings, the total number of enrolled students in those offerings, the number of enrolled students for the subject, the average number of enrolled students for all such subjects, and classify each subject as 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' if its enrollment is at least 10% greater than the average, 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' if at least 10% less than the average, or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Do not return any rounded answers.
gold_sql: WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT so.SUBJECT_KEY, so.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS offering_count, SUM(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so ON sos.SUBJECT_ID = so.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON so.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE so.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' GROUP BY so.SUBJECT_KEY, so.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_KEY, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.offering_count, inner_cte.total_units, SUM(so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_KEY = so.SUBJECT_KEY GROUP BY inner_cte.SUBJECT_KEY, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.offering_count, inner_cte.total_units), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t2.SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND t0.CLUSTER_TYPE = 'S'), avg_enrollment AS (SELECT AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, a.avg_enrolled, CASE WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > a.avg_enrolled * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < a.avg_enrolled * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN avg_enrollment AS a) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_KEY, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.offering_count, s1.total_units, s1.total_enrolled_students, s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s2.avg_enrolled, s2.enrollment_category FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_TITLE = s2.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_KEY

question: For each department, what is the department's name, the range and variance of the total units for subjects offered by that department in the academic year 2022 and that are also listed in the CIS course catalog, as well as the average and variance of the total units for its courses that have a non-null subject title and total units greater than 0? Additionally, for each department, provide the number of unique subject codes offered in 2022 that are also in the CIS course catalog. Present the department name, units range, variance of units range, average units, variance of average units, and the count of unique subject codes in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
gold_sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, (AVG(CAST(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS AS REAL) * CAST(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS AS REAL)) - AVG(CAST(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS AS REAL)) * AVG(CAST(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS AS REAL))) AS units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_range DESC), dept_avg_variance_units AS (SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units, (AVG(CAST(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS AS REAL) * CAST(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS AS REAL)) - AVG(CAST(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS AS REAL)) * AVG(CAST(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS AS REAL))) AS units_variance FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE NOT CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NULL AND CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_variance DESC), dept_subject_code_count AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_CODE) AS unique_subject_codes FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.units_range, inner_cte.units_variance AS range_variance, dau.avg_units, dau.units_variance AS avg_variance, dscc.unique_subject_codes FROM inner_cte JOIN dept_avg_variance_units AS dau ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dau.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN dept_subject_code_count AS dscc ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dscc.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For each organization that has both rooms on floor 2 or higher and at least one associated space unit with a non-null DLC key, and where the average access level of rooms assigned to that organization is greater than the overall average access level across all rooms, list the organization name, the average access level of rooms assigned to that organization, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of those access levels, the average space unit code assigned to the organization, the variance of those space unit codes, and calculate the access to space ratio rounded (average access level divided by average space unit code).
gold_sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH OrgAccessStats AS (SELECT ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(ACCESS_LEVEL) AS avg_access_level, SQRT(ABS(AVG(CAST(ACCESS_LEVEL AS REAL) * CAST(ACCESS_LEVEL AS REAL)) - AVG(CAST(ACCESS_LEVEL AS REAL)) * AVG(CAST(ACCESS_LEVEL AS REAL)))) AS access_level_stddev FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE FLOOR >= 2 GROUP BY ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY access_level_stddev DESC), DeptSpaceStats AS (SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS avg_space_unit_code, (AVG(CAST(su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE AS REAL) * CAST(su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE AS REAL)) - AVG(CAST(su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE AS REAL)) * AVG(CAST(su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE AS REAL))) AS var_space_unit_code FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS fodk JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON fodk.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS su ON fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE NOT fodk.DLC_KEY IS NULL GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY var_space_unit_code DESC) SELECT oas.ORGANIZATION_NAME, oas.avg_access_level, oas.access_level_stddev, dss.avg_space_unit_code, dss.var_space_unit_code, ROUND(CAST(oas.avg_access_level AS REAL) / NULLIF(dss.avg_space_unit_code, 0), 2) AS access_to_space_ratio FROM OrgAccessStats AS oas JOIN DeptSpaceStats AS dss ON oas.ORGANIZATION_NAME = dss.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY access_to_space_ratio DESC) SELECT * FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_access_level > (SELECT AVG(ACCESS_LEVEL) FROM ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD)

question: For each academic year, what is the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the maximum enrollment for IAP activities offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18) (considering only years with more than five activities), the corresponding academic year description, the department phone number, the school name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by the Mathematics department in non-summer, non-current terms, and whether the average total units for that year is classified as 'HIGH_LOAD', 'LOW_LOAD', or 'AVERAGE' (based on being at least 10% above or below the overall average)? gold_sql: WITH stddev_max_enrollment_per_year AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, SQRT(ABS(CAST((SUM(CAST(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT AS REAL) * CAST(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT AS REAL)) - gold_sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, SQRT(ABS(AVG(CAST(sos.TOTAL_UNITS AS REAL) * CAST(sos.TOTAL_UNITS AS REAL)) - AVG(CAST(sos.TOTAL_UNITS AS REAL)) * AVG(CAST(sos.TOTAL_UNITS AS REAL)))) AS stddev_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.COURSE, inner_cte.avg_total_units, inner_cte.stddev_total_units, subj_count.Total_Subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE, COUNT(DISTINCT sos.SUBJECT_ID) AS Total_Subjects FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE) AS subj_count ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subj_count.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND inner_cte.COURSE = subj_count.COURSE ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.COURSE

question: For the top 10 subject titles by the number of reserved library materials for subjects offered in the term '2009SP', what are the subject title, the offering department name, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department (considering only departments that grant degrees and subjects with a non-null subject code description), and the count of reserved materials? Please provide the subject title, the offering department name, the variance, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and the count of reserved materials, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
gold_sql: WITH DepartmentEnrollmentStats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, (AVG(CAST(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS REAL) * CAST(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS REAL)) - AVG(CAST(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS REAL)) * AVG(CAST(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS REAL))) AS enrolled_students_variance, SQRT(ABS(AVG(CAST(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS REAL) * CAST(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS REAL)) - AVG(CAST(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS REAL)) * AVG(CAST(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS REAL)))) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NULL GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC), TopReservedSubjects AS (SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserved_materials FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS l JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY reserved_materials DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT trs.SUBJECT_TITLE, trs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, des.enrolled_students_variance, des.enrolled_students_stddev, trs.reserved_materials FROM TopReservedSubjects AS trs JOIN DepartmentEnrollmentStats AS des ON trs.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = des.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY trs.reserved_materials DESC

question: For rooms on floor 2 that are associated with a DLC having more than five organizations, provide the building room, space usage, organization name, HR org unit title, department name, the minimum access level in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by the building component, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the organization numbers for organizations associated with that DLC, and the DLC name and HR org unit level. Sort the table by the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of organization numbers (descending), DLC name, and then by building room. Do not return any rounded answers.
gold_sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DLCOrgStddev AS (SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_NAME, SQRT(ABS(AVG(CAST(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER AS REAL) * CAST(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER AS REAL)) - AVG(CAST(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER AS REAL)) * AVG(CAST(FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER AS REAL)))) AS org_number_stddev FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION ON FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY.DLC_KEY = FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY WHERE NOT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER IS NULL GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY org_number_stddev DESC), Floor2Rooms AS (SELECT t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.SPACE_USAGE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DLC_NAME, MIN(t0.ACCESS_LEVEL) OVER (ORDER BY t0.BUILDING_COMPONENT ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL FROM ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t2 ON t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.FLOOR = 2) SELECT f2r.BUILDING_ROOM, f2r.SPACE_USAGE, f2r.ORGANIZATION_NAME, f2r.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, f2r.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, f2r.window_column, dos.org_number_stddev, f2r.DLC_NAME, f2r.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL FROM Floor2Rooms AS f2r JOIN DLCOrgStddev AS dos ON f2r.DLC_NAME = dos.DLC_NAME) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(DLC_NAME) OVER (ORDER BY org_number_stddev DESC, DLC_NAME, BUILDING_ROOM) = DLC_NAME THEN NULL ELSE DLC_NAME END AS DLC_NAME, BUILDING_ROOM, SPACE_USAGE, ORGANIZATION_NAME, HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, window_column, org_number_stddev, HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL FROM inner_cte ORDER BY org_number_stddev DESC, DLC_NAME, BUILDING_ROOM

question: For the Mathematics department (Course 18), what is the department name and the total number of enrolled students in both library and tip subjects for terms in 2014FA or 2017JA where the total number of enrolled students is greater than 10, and for each such department, list the subject title, number of enrolled students, school name, and the dense rank over the department code ordered by department code for subjects with more than 0 enrolled students in departments that grant degrees? Do not return any rounded answers.

question: Show the MIT ID, full name, department name, student year, the running sum of MIT IDs within each student year group ordered by MIT ID, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered in regular academic terms for their department (excluding 'Mathematics'), and the total number of distinct courses offered by their department, for students whose employee type is 'Student', who are in department 6 (Electrical Engineering and Computer Science), and whose department name is 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'. Do not return any rounded answers.
gold_sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sp.MIT_ID, sp.FULL_NAME, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, SUM(sp.MIT_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY msd.STUDENT_YEAR ORDER BY sp.MIT_ID) AS running_sum_mit_id FROM SE_PERSON AS sp JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON sp.FULL_NAME = msd.FULL_NAME WHERE sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE = 'Student' AND msd.DEPARTMENT = 6 AND msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ORDER BY msd.STUDENT_YEAR, sp.MIT_ID), DepartmentUnitVariation AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, CAST(SQRT(ABS(AVG(CAST(c.TOTAL_UNITS AS REAL) * CAST(c.TOTAL_UNITS AS REAL)) - AVG(CAST(c.TOTAL_UNITS AS REAL)) * AVG(CAST(c.TOTAL_UNITS AS REAL)))) AS REAL) / NULLIF(AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0), DepartmentCourseCount AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_NUMBER) AS total_courses FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT icte.MIT_ID, icte.FULL_NAME, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.STUDENT_YEAR, icte.running_sum_mit_id, duv.coefficient_of_variation, dcc.total_courses FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN DepartmentUnitVariation AS duv ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = duv.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN DepartmentCourseCount AS dcc ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dcc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY icte.STUDENT_YEAR, icte.MIT_ID

question: For each department that grants degrees and is not the Biology department (Course 7), and for each subject with a non-null subject code description, what is the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, and what is the average number of enrolled students per subject? gold_sql: WITH most_recent_year_stats AS (SELECT COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, (AVG(CAST(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS AS REAL) * CAST(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS AS REAL)) - AVG(CAST(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS AS REAL)) * AVG(CAST(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS AS REAL))) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_ID = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.SUBJECT_ID WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED) GROUP BY COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC), regular_term_stats AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, (AVG(CAST(c.TOTAL_UNITS AS REAL) * CAST(c.TOTAL_UNITS AS REAL)) - AVG(CAST(c.TOTAL_UNITS AS REAL)) * AVG(CAST(c.TOTAL_UNITS AS REAL))) AS total_units_variance FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC) SELECT mry.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mry.avg_total_units AS most_recent_year_avg_total_units, mry.total_units_range AS most_recent_year_total_units_range, mry.total_units_variance AS most_recent_year_total_units_variance, rts.avg_total_units AS regular_term_avg_total_units, rts.total_units_range AS regular_term_total_units_range, rts.total_units_variance AS regular_term_total_units_variance FROM most_recent_year_stats AS mry JOIN regular_term_stats AS rts ON mry.DEPARTMENT_NAME = rts.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For each major use description and organization name where the room area is greater than 100 and the access level is 1, list the number of rooms, the minimum floor number, the access level name, the variance of the number of rooms in the building history for buildings with a nonzero number of rooms and assignable area greater than 0, and the total assignable area of those buildings, with the results ordered by major use description and organization name. question: List the space unit key, organization name, DLC name, DLC key from FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY, the rank of each record within each DLC key group ordered by space unit key, the geometric mean of the number of supervisees for each department in that organization (considering only departments where the number of supervisees is greater than zero), and the total square footage assigned to each organization, for each space unit with a space unit code of 402100. Do not return any rounded answers.
gold_sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH org_geom_mean_supervisees AS (SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES))) AS geometric_mean_supervisees FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN SPACE_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY = SPACE_UNIT.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE ON SPACE_UNIT.DLC_KEY = SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.DEPT_NAMES WHERE SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES > 0 GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean_supervisees DESC), space_unit_402100 AS (SELECT t2.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.DLC_NAME, t0.DLC_KEY, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DLC_KEY ORDER BY t2.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS t2 ON t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 402100) SELECT s.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, s.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s.DLC_NAME, s.DLC_KEY, s.window_column, o.geometric_mean_supervisees FROM space_unit_402100 AS s LEFT JOIN org_geom_mean_supervisees AS o ON s.ORGANIZATION_NAME = o.ORGANIZATION_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.DLC_NAME, inner_cte.DLC_KEY, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.geometric_mean_supervisees, org_sqft.total_sqft FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN (SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, SUM(SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.SQFT) AS total_sqft FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN SPACE_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY = SPACE_UNIT.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE ON SPACE_UNIT.DLC_KEY = SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.DEPT_NAMES GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME) AS org_sqft ON inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME = org_sqft.ORGANIZATION_NAME

question: For each subject category and enrollment type where the maximum enrollment is greater than 10, provide the number of activities, the earliest start date of the corresponding academic term, the latest end date of the corresponding academic term, and for each IAP subject activity with a maximum enrollment of 12 in that enrollment type, show the activity title, maximum enrollment, term description, subject title, number of enrolled students, the academic year description, and the row number within each enrollment type group ordered by activity title. question: For each subject code where the department is degree-granting and the department is Mathematics, show the subject code, subject code description, department name, the running sum of department budget codes within each school (ordered by department code), and for the same department, also show the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of courses offered by that department, considering only departments that are degree granting, courses that have more than 0 total units, and excluding the Chemistry and Biology departments. gold_sql: WITH MathSubjectCodes AS (SELECT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, ssc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.SCHOOL_CODE, SUM(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY sd.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_sum_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND ssc.SCHOOL_CODE = sd.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE), DegreeGrantingDeptStats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, (AVG(CAST(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS AS REAL) * CAST(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS AS REAL)) - AVG(CAST(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS AS REAL)) * AVG(CAST(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS AS REAL))) AS total_units_variance, SQRT(ABS(AVG(CAST(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS AS REAL) * CAST(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS AS REAL)) - AVG(CAST(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS AS REAL)) * AVG(CAST(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS AS REAL)))) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND NOT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY total_units_variance DESC) SELECT msc.SUBJECT_CODE, msc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, msc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msc.running_sum_dept_budget_code, dgs.avg_total_units, dgs.total_units_variance, dgs.total_units_stddev FROM MathSubjectCodes AS msc JOIN DegreeGrantingDeptStats AS dgs ON msc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dgs.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY msc.DEPARTMENT_CODE

question: For the Mathematics department, which offers more than five courses, what are the department name, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for its courses, the school name, the average total units for subjects offered by the department, the range and variance of total units, and whether the department is classified as 'HIGH_UNIT', 'LOW_UNIT', or 'AVERAGE' based on whether its average total units is at least 10% greater than, at least 10% less than, or within 10% of the overall average for degree-granting departments (excluding Chemistry and only including subjects with more than 0 total units)? gold_sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH org_area_stddev AS (SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, SQRT(ABS(AVG(CAST(fr.AREA AS REAL) * CAST(fr.AREA AS REAL)) - AVG(CAST(fr.AREA AS REAL)) * AVG(CAST(fr.AREA AS REAL)))) AS area_stddev FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS fr JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON fr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'ADMISSIONS' GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME HAVING COUNT(fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) > 5), building_floor_stats AS (SELECT fb.BUILDING_NAME, AVG(ff.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS avg_assignable_area, SQRT(ABS(AVG(CAST(ff.ASSIGNABLE_AREA AS REAL) * CAST(ff.ASSIGNABLE_AREA AS REAL)) - AVG(CAST(ff.ASSIGNABLE_AREA AS REAL)) * AVG(CAST(ff.ASSIGNABLE_AREA AS REAL)))) AS stddev_assignable_area, fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM FCLT_BUILDING AS fb JOIN FCLT_FLOOR AS ff ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fb.SITE = 'MIT' AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY <> '39' GROUP BY fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fb.BUILDING_NAME HAVING COUNT(ff.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY) > 1) SELECT bfs.BUILDING_NAME, bfs.avg_assignable_area, bfs.stddev_assignable_area, oas.ORGANIZATION_NAME, oas.area_stddev, bfs.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY FROM building_floor_stats AS bfs LEFT JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS fr ON bfs.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY LEFT JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON fr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY LEFT JOIN org_area_stddev AS oas ON fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME = oas.ORGANIZATION_NAME WHERE NOT oas.ORGANIZATION_NAME IS NULL GROUP BY bfs.BUILDING_NAME, bfs.avg_assignable_area, bfs.stddev_assignable_area, oas.ORGANIZATION_NAME, oas.area_stddev, bfs.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) SELECT ic.BUILDING_NAME, ic.avg_assignable_area, ic.stddev_assignable_area, ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ic.area_stddev, (fb.ASSIGNABLE_AREA - COALESCE(hb.avg_hist_assignable_area, 0)) AS deviation_from_hist_avg FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS fb ON ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY LEFT JOIN (SELECT FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, AVG(ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS avg_hist_assignable_area FROM FCLT_BUILDING_HIST GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING_KEY) AS hb ON ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = hb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY ic.BUILDING_NAME, ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME
