question: For each department in the Mathematics department (Course 18), provide the department name, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for reserved library materials, the variation category (indicating whether the coefficient is 'HIGH_VARIATION', 'LOW_VARIATION', or 'AVERAGE' compared to the average coefficient across all departments), the average of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects that are offered this year and are letter graded), the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for those subjects, the school name, and the department phone number. Only consider records where the material status is 'U' and the term status indicator is 'P'. Do not return any rounded answers.
gold_sql: WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, CAST(SQRT(ABS(AVG(CAST(ss.TOTAL_UNITS AS REAL) * CAST(ss.TOTAL_UNITS AS REAL)) - AVG(CAST(ss.TOTAL_UNITS AS REAL)) * AVG(CAST(ss.TOTAL_UNITS AS REAL)))) AS REAL) / NULLIF(AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON lrm.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON ata.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0), avg_coeff AS (SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient FROM inner_cte1), variation_cte AS (SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.coefficient_of_variation, CASE WHEN i.coefficient_of_variation > a.avg_coefficient * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIATION' WHEN i.coefficient_of_variation < a.avg_coefficient * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIATION' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variation_category FROM inner_cte1 AS i CROSS JOIN avg_coeff AS a), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, (AVG(CAST(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS AS REAL) * CAST(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS AS REAL)) - AVG(CAST(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS AS REAL)) * AVG(CAST(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS AS REAL))) AS total_units_variance, SQRT(ABS(AVG(CAST(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS AS REAL) * CAST(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS AS REAL)) - AVG(CAST(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS AS REAL)) * AVG(CAST(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS AS REAL)))) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME), dept_info AS (SELECT inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.avg_total_units, inner_cte2.total_units_variance, inner_cte2.total_units_stddev, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte2 LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT v.DEPARTMENT_NAME, v.coefficient_of_variation, v.variation_category, d.avg_total_units, d.total_units_variance, d.total_units_stddev, d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM variation_cte AS v JOIN dept_info AS d ON v.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY v.coefficient_of_variation DESC

question: For each subject in the Engineering school with total units equal to 1, what are the subject ID, subject title, department name, academic year, the rank of each subject within its academic year group ordered by subject ID, the term description, the term start date, and, for each subject, the minimum record count from TIP_DETAIL and the total new shelf price from TIP_MATERIAL for materials with a non-null author and a material info source of 'ISBN'? Do not return any rounded answers.
gold_sql: WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT MIN(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS min_record_count, SUM(tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE) AS total_new_shelf_price, td.SUBJECT_ID FROM TIP_DETAIL AS td JOIN TIP_MATERIAL AS tm ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY WHERE NOT tm.AUTHOR IS NULL AND tm.MATERIAL_INFO_SOURCE = 'ISBN' GROUP BY td.SUBJECT_ID) SELECT SUBJECT_ID, min_record_count, total_new_shelf_price FROM inner_cte), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column, t1.TERM_CODE FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t1 INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 1) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.window_column, t3.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t3.TERM_START_DATE FROM inner_cte INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t3 ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = t3.TERM_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID) SELECT s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.window_column, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.TERM_START_DATE, s1.min_record_count, s1.total_new_shelf_price FROM subq2 AS s2 LEFT JOIN subq1 AS s1 ON s2.SUBJECT_ID = s1.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.SUBJECT_ID

question: For each subject code where the department is degree granting and the department is Mathematics, show the subject code, subject code description, department name, school name, the average department budget code within each school, the maximum total units of any subject offered by that department in 2024 (excluding Physics), and the subject title for that subject, considering only subjects that are offered this year and have more than 9 total units, ordered by department name, subject code, and subject title. question: List, for each department, either (a) the department name, average total units, range of total units, and variance of total units for subjects offered in the 2022FA term (excluding Mathematics/Course 18), or (b) the department name, department full name, and maximum total units among subjects offered in the 2021FA term (for degree-granting departments except Chemistry), along with a reason for inclusion ('2022FA Stats' for 2022FA statistics, '2021FA Max' for 2021FA maximum), showing the columns in the order: department name, average total units, total units range, total units variance, department full name, maximum total units, reason. Do not return any rounded answers.
gold_sql: WITH DeptUnits2022FA AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, (AVG(CAST(sos.TOTAL_UNITS AS REAL) * CAST(sos.TOTAL_UNITS AS REAL)) - AVG(CAST(sos.TOTAL_UNITS AS REAL)) * AVG(CAST(sos.TOTAL_UNITS AS REAL))) AS total_units_variance FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sos.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND scd.DEPARTMENT <> '18' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_units_range DESC), DeptMaxUnits2021FA AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS MAX_TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 0 ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), CombinedDeptStats AS (SELECT d2022.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d2022.avg_total_units, d2022.total_units_range, d2022.total_units_variance, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, NULL AS MAX_TOTAL_UNITS, '2022FA Stats' AS Reason FROM DeptUnits2022FA AS d2022 UNION ALL SELECT d2021.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS avg_total_units, NULL AS total_units_range, NULL AS total_units_variance, d2021.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, d2021.MAX_TOTAL_UNITS, '2021FA Max' AS Reason FROM DeptMaxUnits2021FA AS d2021) SELECT * FROM CombinedDeptStats ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, Reason

question: For the Mathematics department, list the department name, the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered in the 2022 academic year that are letter graded, and the average, range, and variance of the number of enrolled students in courses offered by that department, considering only courses with more than 0 enrolled students. question: For each of the top 3 most frequently offered courses in the Mathematics department, provide the course number from SIS_SUBJECT_CODE, the course description from SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION, the subject title from CIS_COURSE_CATALOG, the number of times each course is offered, and for the department associated with each course, also provide the department name, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in the subjects it offers (considering only subjects with more than 0 enrolled students and excluding the Chemistry department), and the total number of unique subjects offered by that department. List the results ordered by offer count descending, then by coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) descending. Do not return any rounded answers.
gold_sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ssc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE, COUNT(*) AS offer_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ssc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY offer_count DESC LIMIT 3), DeptStudentVariation AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, CAST(SQRT(ABS(CAST((SUM(CAST(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS REAL) * CAST(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS REAL)) - CAST(SUM(CAST(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS REAL)) * SUM(CAST(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS REAL)) AS REAL) / COUNT(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS)) AS REAL) / NULLIF(COUNT(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - 1, 0))) AS REAL) / AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 1), DeptSubjectCounts AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT sos.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_unique_subjects FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT icte.COURSE_NUMBER, icte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.offer_count, dsv.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dsv.coefficient_of_variation, dsc.total_unique_subjects FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON icte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION = scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN DeptStudentVariation AS dsv ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dsv.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN DeptSubjectCounts AS dsc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dsc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY icte.offer_count DESC, dsv.coefficient_of_variation DESC

question: For each department that is the Mathematics department and has at least one tip subject offered in the term '2019FA', show the department name, the highest variance of the number of enrolled students in library subjects offered by that department across all terms, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units of subjects offered by that department (considering only departments that grant degrees and subjects with more than zero total units), and indicate whether the department is a 'HIGH_VARIANCE' (variance at least 20% greater than the average variance across all such departments), 'LOW_VARIANCE' (variance at least 20% less than the average), or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Present the columns in the following order: department name, highest variance of enrolled students, variance of total units, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of total units, and variance category. Do not return any rounded answers.

AVG(CAST(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS REAL)) * AVG(CAST(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS REAL))) AS enrolled_students_variance, SQRT(ABS(AVG(CAST(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS REAL) * CAST(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS REAL)) - AVG(CAST(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS REAL)) * AVG(CAST(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS REAL)))) AS enrolled_students_stddev FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(enrolled_students_variance) AS highest_enrolled_students_variance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, (AVG(CAST(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS AS REAL) * CAST(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS AS REAL)) - AVG(CAST(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS AS REAL)) * AVG(CAST(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS AS REAL))) AS total_units_variance, SQRT(ABS(AVG(CAST(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS AS REAL) * CAST(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS AS REAL)) - AVG(CAST(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS AS REAL)) * AVG(CAST(SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS AS REAL)))) AS total_units_stddev FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME), avg_var_cte AS (SELECT AVG(total_units_variance) AS avg_variance FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.total_units_variance, i.total_units_stddev, CASE WHEN i.total_units_variance > a.avg_variance * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN i.total_units_variance < a.avg_variance * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN avg_var_cte AS a ORDER BY i.total_units_variance DESC) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.highest_enrolled_students_variance, s2.total_units_variance, s2.total_units_stddev, s2.variance_category FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME
